summary: Possible typosquat of @solana-labs/anchor with unverified bundled code
details: Package @solana-labs/ancor@1.98.103 has a name one character off from the legitimate @solana-labs/anchor scope/package, which is a confusion-risk pattern worth human review. The shipped lib/index.cjs.js and lib/index.esm.js are minified bundles that include child_process imports alongside fetch/https.get calls and POST handling — keyword co-occurrence in a minified rollup is consistent with both legitimate SDK builds (which commonly bundle HTTP clients and conditional Node helpers) and exfiltration shapes, and could not be disambiguated from the bundle alone in this scan. No specific attacker-controlled endpoint, credential read, or install-time hook was identified. Routing for human review to confirm name intent against @solana-labs/anchor and to inspect the bundle's actual outbound destinations and child_process call sites.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
